name: Call of Air
summary: A shaman is sent to Veyric Thundervein in the northern hills of Arathi Highlands. He will teach you more about mastering air.

sections.title: The Northern Hills
sections.body: A shaman sends you north into Arathi Highlands to find Veyric Thundervein. The element of air is difficult to master, and he can teach you more. Your growing skill has brought you this far; now your training turns to wind and the spirits of air.

faq.answer: Veyric Thundervein is in the northern hills of Arathi Highlands, where he can teach you more about air.
Find Veyric Thundervein in the northern hills of Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What is Call of Air about?
faq.answer: A shaman sends you to Veyric Thundervein so he can teach you more about the element of air.

faq.q: Why am I going to Arathi Highlands?
faq.answer: Veyric Thundervein is in the northern hills of Arathi Highlands, and he will teach you more about air.
Veyric teaches you to focus wind spells and call upon the spirits of air.
